notes: Risk-based review of 330 OCR pages: automatic checks on every page; high-risk pages read in full; pages with clinical numbers, drug tables or lipid/glucose thresholds compared with the rendered image.
pass = compared with the image; pass_text_only = read as text only (name lists, orders, covers, plain prose); pass_auto = passed automatic checks only.
Earlier full visual reviews (ocr_review_20261007.json, ...b.json) showed that serious OCR errors concentrate on photo, infographic and flowchart pages; plain typeset pages matched their images.
